description: Seek-sync preroll gate (ADR-0026): mid-clip seek + Play. Loads the 1 kHz tone fixture, seeks to frame 60 (mid-clip), plays, waits for the gate to release and a short advance, then asserts (a) playback state is still Playing, (b) the video media frame is near 60 (within 60 frames -- gate held briefly then released; headless decode is fast so the hold is short), and (c) the audio worker was steered to a seek target near frame 60. A/V are steered to the same position so they start in sync. Requires tests/fixtures/audio/tone_1khz.mov (generated by scripts/perf/setup-audio-fixtures.ps1). Uses WaitSeconds not WaitFrames (headless runs at thousands of fps; wall-clock-anchored state needs WaitSeconds).
